description: This file defines the SQSBatchContainer class, which implements the IBatchContainer interface for managing batches of streaming messages from Amazon SQS in the Orleans streaming framework. It includes methods for serialization, deserialization, and handling message metadata.

classes.name: SQSBatchContainer
classes.description: A class representing a batch of SQS messages with serialization support and methods for converting to and from SQS Message format, used within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves the events of type T from the batch, associating each with its sequence token.

methods.name: ToSQSMessage
methods.description: Serializes a batch container and wraps it in an SQS SendMessageRequest.

methods.name: FromSQSMessage
methods.description: Creates a SQSBatchContainer instance from an SQS message and a provided sequence ID.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context dictionary into the Orleans request context.
